title: UE not using satellite E-UTRAN access

entities.name: UE supporting CE mode B
entities.description: A UE that supports CE mode B and operates in WB-S1 mode not using satellite E-UTRAN access. The UE's usage setting is not set to voice centric.

entities.name: Enhanced coverage not restricted
entities.description: Condition where the use of enhanced coverage is not restricted for the UE.

entities.name: CE mode B not restricted
entities.description: Condition where CE mode B is not restricted for the UE.

entities.name: NAS timer for WB-S1/CE mode
entities.description: Applicable NAS timer values indicated in tables 10.2.1, 10.3.1 for UE and tables 10.2.2, 10.3.2 for MME for WB-S1/CE mode.

entities.name: MME supporting WB-S1 mode with CE mode B UE
entities.description: MME that supports WB-S1 mode and performs NAS signalling with a UE not using satellite E-UTRAN access which supports CE mode B and operates in WB-S1 mode.

entities.name: NAS procedure
entities.description: Generic NAS procedure during which NAS timer values are calculated at start and not re-calculated until completion, restart, or abortion.

relations.description: UE applies NAS timer value for WB-S1/CE mode when enhanced coverage is not restricted or CE mode B is not restricted.
Condition that the use of enhanced coverage is not restricted for the UE guards the application of NAS timer value.
Condition that CE mode B is not restricted for the UE guards the application of NAS timer value.
MME calculates NAS timer value for WB-S1/CE mode when enhanced coverage is not restricted or CE mode B is not restricted.
Condition that the use of enhanced coverage is not restricted for the UE guards the MME's calculation of NAS timer value.
Condition that CE mode B is not restricted for the UE guards the MME's calculation of NAS timer value.
NAS timer value is calculated at start of a NAS procedure and not re-calculated until the procedure is completed, restarted, or aborted.
